title: Closing thanks
summary: Welburn thanks McRae on behalf of the Jazz Oral History Project and McRae says it was a joy.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well, Teddy, looks like we've come full circle on this. I want to thank you on behalf of the Jazz Oral History Project for the National Endowment for the Arts, for giving us this interview.

And it's certainly going to be a welcome addition with such thorough knowledge and detail that you provided us on your career, and also an insight into the music of the 1920's through the present. Thanks very much.
Thank you very much for having me, too. I hope that I, you know, could give you enough --
-- musicians coming up to learn something from what we did back in the 30's and 40's on up to the present time.

And it's been a real joy for me to do this. It's something I always look forward to doing.
And I wanna thank you very much and the school and everybody for having me here.
